hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 bonding curve token launchpad that deploys new ERC-20 tokens with a concentrated liquidity bonding curve (75% of supply). When the bonding curve supply is exhausted, the hook migrates liquidity into two single-sided concentrated positions in a new AMM pool. A fixed 1% fee on each swap is split equally between the token creator and a platform fee recipient via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism.
